description: Metro Libre and Crítica give no simultaneous count for any site on 3 Dec; all site candidates remain pending_threshold or pending_evidence. No counts aggregated across sites.
Crítica reports an intention to carry out daily actions with intermittent closures, but searches did not establish actual subsequent occurrences or duration.

Seven Spanish searches covered date/sector keywords, CSS/SUNTRACS and regions. Search results were noisy and do not establish exhaustive provincial, labor, student, health, utility, indigenous or local coverage.

Two rendered article responses were saved in full despite the capture plan; exact files/hashes and handling are recorded in retention_deviation.json. Files remain unchanged; do not reproduce full text in summaries.
Official monthly baseline not assessed; baseline gate pending.
